newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee gains vs forward dlr on RBI purchase.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee gains vs forward dlr on RBI purchase.

text.p: The Indian rupee extended its gains against the forward dollar on Thursday after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) resumed its purchases, dealers said.
"They are buying outright forwards again," said a dealer at a European bank's Bombay office.
The RBI has been buying dollars in recent months to arrest the rupee's rise against the U.S. currency.
September dollar premium was quoted at 1.33/1.36 rupees in latest deals, up from the opening level of 1.28/1.31 rupees.
Dealers said they were not aware if the RBI bought in the spot market on Thursday.
Spot dollar was quoted at 35.85/86 in latest deals.
